items.description: A Rust library that provides space-efficient, in-memory representations for integer vectors. It offers two complementary data structures: FixedVec, which uses fixed-width encoding for O(1) mutable and atomic access, and IntVec, which uses variable-length instantaneous codes for high-ratio compression and amortized O(1) random access.
